notes.title: Episode 4 Released!
notes.content:
This update allows players to join Ari and Zoe on their 4th time-traveling adventure through the industrial revolution! 
What's new?
[list]
[*] New Episode 4 content, including new art, RAD mechanics and story!
[*] Updates to the RAD in previous episodes, including expanding the Scene View!
[/list]

notes.title: Episode 3 Released!
notes.content:
This update includes a whole new episode to continue Ari and Zoe's journey through time!
What's new?
-Episode 3 content, including new art, RAD mechanics and story!
-Minor bug fixes throughout the entire game

notes.title: Episode 2 Released!
notes.content:
This update includes a whole new episode to continue Ari and Zoe's journey through time!
What's new:
-Episode 2 content
-updated graphics and art for the whole game

A note for all returning players: Thank you for your continued enjoyment of Time Tails! One of our major updates was a much-needed overhaul of our saving system. This means that any previously saved data will be lost, and all players will need to start a new game. We apologize for any inconvenience this causes.  We hope you enjoy the rest of our update!
